entry.summary: Svalbard is outside Schengen and needs no visa of its own, but every route goes through mainland Norway, so Schengen entry applies on the way.
entry.next_check: Read the Governor of Svalbard's visitor rules (firearms and polar bear safety outside settlements, field travel notification).

health-entry.notes: No yellow fever certificate is needed for entry (as reported to WHO in 2022). WHO lists no separate rule; entry is under Norway's rules. WHO advises confirming with the embassy before travel.
